summary: Verified navbar clickability-on-scroll fix and intro overlay removal on desktop viewport 1440x900. All assertions passed: intro-loader removed from DOM ~3s after load; after scrolling 600px via lenis, elementFromPoint on nav-reserve-btn, nav-menu, nav-filosofia, nav-galleria, nav-contatti centers returns the button itself (isSelfOrChild: True). Clicking nav-reserve-btn opens reservation-modal. Clicking nav-menu smooth-scrolls to menu-section (scrollY moved from 600 -> 1673, menu-section top=80 in-view). Body height 8258px confirms long scrollable page. Bug is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' — appears to originate from lenis or an intersection/scroll utility. Non-blocking but worth investigating the root container CSS position.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar z-[70] + IntroLoader pointer-events-none + unmount on animationend/2200ms fallback works as intended. Reservation modal is z-[90] and correctly intercepts pointer events when open (expected). If reopening tests, close modal by clicking the close (X) button rather than Escape (Escape did not close modal in test).
rca of the issue: Original bug: intro-loader overlay (fixed inset-0 z-[100]) was covering navbar buttons after scroll. Fix applied by main agent: IntroLoader now uses class 'pointer-events-none' and unmounts on curtain animationend with a 2200ms setTimeout fallback (finish()). Verified in DOM: [data-testid=intro-loader] not present after 3.5s. elementFromPoint over each nav button center now returns the button itself, confirming no overlay intercepts.
